research_rules: Test one genuinely distinct pre-registered family per research iteration.
Use completed candles, next-open fills, pessimistic intrabar ordering and gap-through-stop prices.
Use development selection, chronological folds, cost stress and one sealed final evaluation.
Correct for multiple testing; never tune on the sealed final.
Reject a signal screen before building execution code when raw cost-adjusted expectancy is negative.
Do not infer monthly profit from a small sample.
A pass permits paper validation only; live requires separate explicit approval.
next_queue: Keep the admitted perpetual 30-day TSMOM forward paper settings frozen and collect real forward evidence.

Investigate the recently documented quarter-hour crypto-futures microstructure effect only if public trade-level data can support a realistic out-of-sample, fee-aware test; do not substitute coarse candles and call it replication.
Screen hourly return autocorrelation/continuation as a distinct short-horizon hypothesis before building execution logic; require raw forward edge to clear realistic round-trip costs.
Revisit walk-forward statistical-arbitrage pairs only with exact funding, current minimums and a matched random-walk false-positive control.
Do not retune the rejected funding-rebound rule on its opened sealed final; any revisit requires new future data or a genuinely new pre-registered mechanism.
Construct a portfolio ensemble only after a second independently admitted, low-correlation edge exists.
